note: Governed component contracts introduced by the 0.9.3 candidate and carried into v0.9.4 unchanged (EvidenceCard, MotifFrame, MotionController, DataTable cellStates, MapLegend states). IDs are stable; an artifact-resolved implementation record copies a contract only for its exact format/runtime. component.brand-motion.01 of the withdrawn 0.9.2 candidate is superseded by component.motif-frame.01. Version 1.2 (0.9.3 candidate revision r2) adds the MOTIF-06 host-surface contract to MotifFrame; 0.9.4 changes no contract (MapLegend classes now resolve color-srgb-07.scales.json, whose class colours are reported under the DATAVIZ-04 hue audit).

contract.purpose: Present one governed value with its state, dataset, source, date, boundary, limitation, permanent URL and receipt id so that a third-party AI answer or a link preview carries provenance the reader can verify.
contract.nonPurpose: It is not a decision card, not a chart, not identity, and never a control; it makes no claim beyond the bound claim record.
contract.contentContract: Props value, unit, state (one of five EVID-05 states), dataset, source, asOf, boundary, limitation, url, receipt; Thai and English label sets; the 3px four-colour rule and the 3 × 3px measure line are decorative and aria-hidden; the one-line text fallback repeats every field in order.

default.behavior: Value, unit, state glyph and label, dataset, source, as-of date, boundary, limitation, permanent link and receipt id are visible on one card without truncation at 320px width.

focus.behavior: The permanent link is the only focusable element and shows the governed focus ring.

selectedCurrent.behavior: The card carries no selection state.

disabled.behavior: An unavailable claim blocks emission instead of rendering a disabled card.

loading.behavior: The card renders only from a resolved claim record.

empty.behavior: A value in state no_data, out_of_scope, suppressed or not_yet renders its glyph, reason and latest available value or expected date; the card never renders an empty value slot.

error.behavior: A record that fails to resolve blocks the card.

success.behavior: Following the link is not a success state.

formatBehavior.behavior: Inline HTML with a one-line text fallback in the same DOM order; no logo, panel, gradient, motif or motion; the card survives copy-paste as plain text.

accessibility.name: The card's accessible name is the value with unit and state in the reader's locale.
accessibility.role: figure with a definition list; the link is a native anchor.
accessibility.value: State is exposed as text, not colour or glyph alone.
accessibility.order: value → state → dataset → source → date → boundary → limitation → link → receipt.
accessibility.status: No live region; the card is static content.

contract.evidencePermissionBoundary: Every field comes from the bound claim record and its evidence capture; the card never widens scope, certainty or permission.
antiPatterns: Logo or gradient on the card
N/A or bare dash
Value without state
Rounded estimate presented as measured
Link that is not permanent
Motion or motif on the card

contract.purpose: Mount one registered motif (dial, rings, layers, slice, cultivate or the logo assembly) from the exact motif.v3 runtime bytes with a declared job and beat, replay it while visible under OWNER-MOTION-01 through the page's MotionController, and hold the governed final-state SVG everywhere else.
contract.nonPurpose: It is not identity of record, not navigation, not a favicon, not evidence, never a control, and never a product overlay (overlays use their own registered runtime).
contract.contentContract: Attributes data-kind (dial|rings|layers|slice|cultivate|logo), data-job (one of the kind's allowedJobs in motif-register.v0.9.4.json; any other value throws and preflight fails), data-beat (opening|transition|closing, matching the kind), data-variant (full|quiet; the light-theme variant), data-variant-dark (optional, quiet only: MOTIF-06 theme swap), data-host-surface (required: a carrier id from motif-register.v0.9.4.json#/carrierPolicy/carriers, themed ids checked per rendered theme, <id>@light|@dark for a fixed ground; the pair must be in carrierPolicy.allowed or the frame is refused and not rendered), data-cycle-ms (≥ 2000; logo 6000); wraps <lm-motif kind=… autoplay="false" [quiet] [ink="blue" for full]> with the kind's final-state SVG in <noscript> (both SVGs in .lds-motif-noscript wrappers, data-theme-variant="light|dark", when data-variant-dark is set); the frame paints invariant and theme-fixed carriers itself and compares the rendered ground behind it with the declared carrier; the frame owns one IntersectionObserver (threshold 0.14, rootMargin 0px 0px -8% 0px), calls play() on enter and every cycle while visible, clears the timer on exit, and subscribes to the page-level MotionController.

default.behavior: The final state is visible before JavaScript runs and after every cycle.

hover.behavior: Hover does not start or stop the cycle.

focus.behavior: The element is aria-hidden and not focusable.

disabled.behavior: Pause is a page-level control, not a component state.

loading.behavior: If the runtime never loads the static SVG stays in place (fail-open).

error.behavior: A MOTIF-06 refusal (carrier not allowed, ink without a governed record, rendered ground ≠ declared carrier, invalid swap) removes the frame from rendering (ladder rung L5) and logs the code; a runtime or SVG hash mismatch, an unregistered job or a forbidden region blocks delivery.

formatBehavior.behavior: Browser only; document, PDF and deck rendered in a browser may mount it; exported static files, email and social creatives use the final-state SVG of the same kind and variant.

accessibility.name: None; aria-hidden decorative motion.
accessibility.status: prefers-reduced-motion holds the final state; pause shows the complete final state.

contract.evidencePermissionBoundary: Motion carries no meaning; identity of record remains the approved PNG files; product overlays remain separate.
antiPatterns: Editing runtime bytes
loop attribute without a viewport check
animation-iteration-count: infinite
Sampled wedge hex
Motif as favicon or OG image
Motif over the first answer, primary proof or primary action
A job outside the kind's allowedJobs
More than three moments on a route
Mixing a product overlay with a shared motif in one lockup
A full variant on Brand Blue, a dark surface or an atmosphere
A quiet variant on a light surface
A frame without data-host-surface
A declared carrier that differs from the painted ground
ink="beige" or another ink without a governed file
Recolouring, plating or scrimming a motif to make it legible

contract.purpose: Provide the single page-level pause/resume control that every MotifFrame (and any other OWNER-MOTION-01 replay) subscribes to; pause holds every motif at its complete final state, resume restarts cycles only for frames still at least 14% visible.
contract.nonPurpose: It is not a per-component toggle, not a preference store beyond the page, and never hides content.
contract.contentContract: One <button class="lds-motion-pause" type="button" aria-pressed="false"> per page with data-label-pause / data-label-resume in the page locale; exposes window.LandometerMotion { pause(), resume(), paused, subscribe(fn) }; MotifFrames register on connect and unregister on disconnect.

default.behavior: Visible, reachable control with the pause label.

activePressed.behavior: aria-pressed true while paused; label switches to resume.

disabled.behavior: Never disabled; with no motion on the page the control is omitted, not disabled.

formatBehavior.behavior: Browser only; static formats have no control because nothing moves.

accessibility.name: Pause motion / Resume motion in the page locale.
accessibility.order: Before the first MotifFrame in reading order or in the page utility bar.
accessibility.status: State change is announced through aria-pressed.

contract.evidencePermissionBoundary: None; the control carries no product meaning.
antiPatterns: More than one controller per page
A controller that hides motifs instead of holding final state
Pause state persisted across pages without user intent

contract.purpose: Present governed rows with a caption, headers, numeric alignment, a mobile strategy, and a cellStates prop that renders each value's EVID-05 state.
contract.nonPurpose: It is not a chart and does not compute or normalise values.
contract.contentContract: Props caption, columns, rows, cellStates (per-cell state from the five-value enum), noDataLabel is retained as a deprecated alias of the no_data label; state cells render the glyph plus reason in text.metadata; no_data rows sort last; suppressed cells print the threshold; not_yet cells print the expected date.

default.behavior: Caption, headers and aligned numeric cells with units.

focus.behavior: Sortable headers, when present, are native buttons with visible focus.

activePressed.behavior: Not applicable beyond native button behaviour.

selectedCurrent.behavior: Sorted column is announced and marked without colour alone.

disabled.behavior: Unavailable sort is omitted, not disabled.

loading.behavior: A loading table keeps its caption and headers and states that rows are loading.

empty.behavior: An empty result states what is unavailable, why, and the next action; it never renders 0 or N/A.

error.behavior: A failed load keeps the last good rows if any and states what failed.

formatBehavior.behavior: Native table; on narrow viewports rows stack with header labels repeated; states keep glyph and reason in every layout.

accessibility.name: Caption is the accessible name.
accessibility.value: State cells expose the state label as text.

contract.evidencePermissionBoundary: Rows come from bound claim/evidence IDs; the table never widens scope.
antiPatterns: N/A
Bare dash
Missing rendered as 0
State by colour alone
text.muted for state labels

contract.purpose: Explain a map overlay: layer, method, classes with units and denominator, and one row per present value state (noData, zero, outOfScope, suppressed, notYet), plus source, date and limitation.
contract.nonPurpose: It is not a control panel and does not restate claims beyond the bound record.
contract.contentContract: Props layer, method, classes (from color-srgb-07.scales.json classes 5/7/9 of one family and the current theme's LUT — dark classes are derived), unit with denominator, states (subset of the five), source, asOf, limitation; each state row shows swatch or pattern, glyph and label in text.metadata.

default.behavior: Classes, unit with denominator, present state rows, source, date and limitation are visible.

loading.behavior: A loading legend keeps its layer name and states that classes are loading.

empty.behavior: A layer with no rendered data shows the out_of_scope statement instead of an empty ramp.

error.behavior: A failed layer states what failed and keeps the last good legend if any.

formatBehavior.behavior: Inline figure adjacent to the map; static formats render the same rows beside the exported map.

accessibility.name: Layer name is the accessible name.
accessibility.value: Class ranges and state labels as text.

contract.evidencePermissionBoundary: Legend text comes from the bound map overlay config; coverage is never implied beyond evidence.
antiPatterns: Two families of one zone on one map
Missing rendered as lowest class
State rows omitted when the state occurs
Denominator omitted from the unit
Hand-typed dark class colours
A class anchor inside a retired hue window
